segments.text: "But you're in trouble, right? Then I'll do something about it!"
The game's heroine, and a noble who lives in Itehari. She is cheerful, positive, and honest. Brimming with curiosity, she is especially interested in the world outside of Itehari.
From Aksys Games
"I don't remember anything that happened before I met you, Milady. So to sum it up... you're all I have."
A well-mannered man who's slightly hard to read. He lost his memories, and was taken in by the heroine when he was in trouble.
From Aksys Games
"If I were mad enough to set the Great Taiju's realm on fire, do you think I would have any problem with killing a lone woman?"

Despite his young age, he is the current head of the entertainment district. While he may be unfriendly and takes an aggressive attitude toward others, he is quite the caretaker and is admired by the entertainment district residents. He is also the leader of the Shiranui, a rebel group.
From Aksys Games
"How many years have we been together? I know everything you're thinking about."

The heroine's caretaker. He's somewhat overbearing, but is a very capable attendant otherwise. However, he tends to express his love in ways that tend to be a little too intense, such as claiming that he is merely a piece of property that belongs to the heroine.
From Aksys Games
"You look like you're really troubled. Do you find the idea of marrying me so unpleasant?"
A steam soldier who maintains order in Itehari as part of the Kurozuru. At a glance, his good looks don't quite match his job, and he has an awful personality in spite of them.
From Aksys Games
"...Yeah. That's something I like about you."
An arcanist and the heroine's friend. He runs Hangetsudo, a shop that does odd-jobs. He doesn't like going out aside from work errands, and will shut himself indoors when left alone.
From Aksys Games
"Where are you headed? I would be happy to escort you there."
Yori's older brother. He may appear strict and strait-laced, but he has a flexible mindset and does not discriminate against commoners.
From Aksys Games
"I do not wish for conflict. I do not wish for the blood of Itehari's people to be spilled."
Known as Itehari's living god. While this is a given for commoners, very few people have actually seen his face, even among nobility.
From Aksys Games
"You and I are nothing more than cogs in the machinery, each one serving its own role."
A resident of Itehari. He's known the heroine since she was a child, and occasionally bumps into her in town. Where he lives and what he does for a living is a mystery.
From Aksys Games
"Why not let Tobari be and come with me instead? I promise you'll be in good hands."
An entertainment district local and second-in-command of the Shiranui. He's more approachable compared to Tobari. Considers Tobari to be his little brother.
From Aksys Games
"How wonderful. Please do let me know if there are any interesting developments."
A friend of the heroine's. She is calm and collected, and a gentle-mannered noblewoman overall.
From Aksys Games
"I could never have dreamed of being treated so kindly by a lady of your standing."
A young girl who works as a geisha in the entertainment district. Meets the heroine through an unexpected turn of events, and eventually befriends her.
From Aksys Games
"...Perhaps you have heard the rumors? These incidents that have been occurring in Itehari are unprecedented."
The prime minister of the Ryuei, the legislative body of Itehari. As the most powerful person after the Taiju, he is in charge of most governmental affairs, essentially making him Itehari's ruler.
From Aksys Games
"I I am nothing more than the Lord Taiju's guard as part of the Kinji."
Serves the Taiju as part of the Kinji. He laments the Taiju's fading authority within Itehari.
From Aksys Games
"Saku is an archivist, remember? While my sources must remain secret, there is nothing in Itehari that escapes my notice!"
A young and elusive archivist. His information doesn't come cheap, but his skills are the real deal, and is known to be calculating and worldly.
From Aksys Games
"Right, right. The words of a cornered coward."
The man who suddenly attacked the heroine.
From Aksys Games
"Ah, you can pay me later. Instead, make sure the kid gets something energizing to eat."
A doctor residing in the Abyss. He is an exiled former noble, and is currently researching the Hari Disease, the epidemic disease of the the Abyss.
From Aksys Games
"Since when did Itehari's nobility start making sightseeing trips to a place like this?"
The leader of a band of thieves with territory in the Abyss. Harbors adverse sentiments toward the residents of Itehari.
From Aksys Games
"Well, aren't you the lucky young man. To be acquainted with such a lovely lady. I might even be a little jealous."
The general of the Kurozuru. He behaves and dresses in a carefree manner unbefitting of his title, and his subordinates are often at the mercy of his whims.
From Aksys Games
"Well, young noblewomen don't typically know much about the going-ons of their divisions..."
The man assigned to be Yori's aide. While he's somewhat clever and capable, he's prone to saying the wrong things at the wrong time.
From Aksys Games
